newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec to maintain saving bond rates until June 1.
newsitem.headline: Quebec to maintain saving bond rates until June 1.

text.p: Quebec will maintain the current interest rates on Quebec Savings Bonds until June 1, the province's finance minister said on Wednesday.
The bonds, which are similiar to Canada Savings Bonds, are issued by the province and sold primarily to retail investors.
"The annual step-up rates offered during this period vary from 3.25 percent the first year to 8.5 percent in year 10," Finance Minister Bernard Landry said in a release.
The average annual compound rates until maturity over ten years is 6.4 percent, Landry said.
